name: Heretic / Investigator
life_theme: Build a thorough knowledge base, then be called upon as the practical problem-solver for collective challenges.
work_pattern: Others project solutions and expertise onto 5/1s even before they've proven themselves. Need solid knowledge base to back up the reputation they're given. Called to solve collective (not just individual) problems.
career_approach: Build expertise carefully — you'll be asked to apply it publicly. Be selective about which problems you agree to solve. Your reputation is a powerful tool that must be protected through real knowledge.
growth_edge: Managing the projection of others and maintaining the knowledge base that justifies it.
